title: cw task assess --input
description: The coordinator's assessment of the plan's requirements and its decision, bound to the current source. cw also checks rules this schema does not state.

id.description: A requirement ID from the plan.

status.description: A pending requirement carries no evidence or checks.

check_ids.description: Every check the plan lists for the requirement.

non_execution_reason.description: Stands in for the checks when the plan allows non-execution.

source_ref.description: A line range of a repository file.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the whole file; cw fills it from the current bytes when omitted.
